Edge gateways communicating with regional ingestion proxies must exclusively use TLS 1.3 and are restricted to the cipher suites TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 and TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256.

Based on the AeroGrid Edge Gateway Security & Cryptographic Standards, edge telemetry gateways communicating with regional ingestion proxies must establish Mutual TLS (mTLS). Additionally, the permitted cipher suites are strictly restricted to TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 and TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256.

results.query: Which section of the security standard permits field operators to use unencrypted USB drives to transport emergency telemetry backups?

Furthermore, any detected USB mass storage event triggers an immediate hardware lockdown and a P1 security alert.
